name: Diona
title: Kätzlein Cocktail
description: A young lady who has inherited trace amounts of non-human blood. She is the incredibly popular bartender of the Cat's Tail tavern.

skills.name: Kätzlein Style
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive shots with a bow.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, biting frost will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged frost arrow will deal Cryo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: Icy Paws
skills.description:
Fires an Icy Paw that deals Cryo DMG to opponents and forms a shield on hit.
The shield's DMG Absorption scales based on Diona's Max HP, and its duration scales off the number of Icy Paws that hit their target.

Press
Rapidly fires off 2 Icy Paws.

Hold
Dashes back quickly before firing 5 Icy Paws.
The shield created by a Hold attack will gain a 75% DMG Absorption Bonus.

The shield has a 250% Cryo DMG Absorption Bonus, and will cause your active character to become affected by Cryo at the point of formation for a short duration.
skills.info: When she first started bartending, Diona found that no matter how much ice she put in her cocktails, it would never do a drunkard any harm. That all changed when she received her Vision — now she can form ice cold enough to cause severe brainfreeze. Five out of five stars!

skills.name: Signature Mix
skills.description:
Tosses out a special cold brew that deals AoE Cryo DMG and creates a Drunken Mist in an AoE.

Drunken Mist
·Deals continuous Cryo DMG to opponents within the AoE.
·Continuously regenerates the HP of characters within the AoE.
skills.info: A horrific mix that even Diona considers inhumane. The horrifying foretaste should be left for one's opponents. It has a crisp aftertaste, but unfortunately, one can only feel it on one's nose and skin.

passives.name: Cat's Tail Secret Menu
passives.description: Characters shielded by Icy Paws have their Movement SPD increased by 10% and their Stamina Consumption decreased by 10%.

passives.name: Drunkards' Farce
passives.description: Opponents who enter the AoE of Signature Mix have 10% decreased ATK for 15s.

passives.name: Complimentary Bar Food
passives.description: When a Perfect Cooking is achieved on a dish with restorative effects, there is a 12% chance to obtain double the product.

constellations.name: A Lingering Flavor
constellations.description: Regenerates 15 Energy for Diona after the effects of Signature Mix end.

constellations.name: Shaken, Not Purred
constellations.description:
Increases Icy Paws' DMG by 15%, and increases its shield's DMG Absorption by 15%.
Additionally, when paws hit their targets, creates a shield for other nearby characters on the field with 50% of the Icy Paws shield's DMG Absorption for 5s.

constellations.name: A—Another Round?
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Signature Mix by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Wine Industry Slayer
constellations.description: Within the radius of Signature Mix, Diona's charge time for aimed shots is reduced by 60%

constellations.name: Double Shot, on the Rocks
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Icy Paws by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Cat's Tail Closing Time
constellations.description:
Characters within Signature Mix's radius will gain the following effects based on their HP amounts:
·Increases Incoming Healing Bonus by 30% when HP falls below or is equal to 50%.
·Elemental Mastery increased by 200 when HP is above 50%.

outfits.name: Sugary Brew
outfits.description: Diona's outfit. The work uniform of the Cat's Tail's star bartender.

voices.title: Hello
voices.text: Diona, bartender of the Cat's Tail! I charge a hefty fee for private events. Huh? You didn't come here for a drink? Hmm... Then I accept your invitation... I suppose...

voices.title: Chat: Relax
voices.text: Ahhh... that stretch feels good.

voices.title: Chat: Thinking
voices.text: Hmm. Lizard Tail, Pepper, Starconch, hmm... what else do I need to create the most dreadfully disgusting cocktail?

voices.title: Chat: Waiting
voices.text: I—I wasn't waiting for you. I just happened to be resting!

voices.title: When It Rains
voices.text: Rain! I hate rain! ...Let's go inside... I—I'm not scared of water, I just... hate it when my clothes get wet.

voices.title: When Thunder Strikes
voices.text: Ahh!!! Uhh, um... I'm not shaking, I'm not... Ohhhh...

voices.title: When It Snows: Playtime
voices.text: Ooh, it's so cold to touch. Wow, it's so much fun!

voices.title: When It Snows: Viewing
voices.text: Ooooh, look at the little white snowflakes dancing in the wind, to and fro, and... whew, isn't it... beautiful! C'mon, c'mon c'mon, sit with me... Watch...

voices.title: When the Sun Is Out
voices.text: Come on, let's go bask in the sun a bit~ ...If you aren't coming, I'll just go by myself~ ...Last chance! Are you coming or not!?

voices.title: Good Morning
voices.text: Morning~ Can you hand me that can of salted loach from the cabinet? Time to destroy the wine industry!

voices.title: Good Afternoon: Strange Noises
voices.text: Wha— Ugh, no! You heard nothing!

voices.title: Good Afternoon: Canned Food
voices.text: Uh, I was saving this can of fish for when I was really hungry. Stop looking at it like that! ...Mmm, okay, I'll let you have a little taste, but nothing more!

voices.title: Good Evening
voices.text: Aw, I failed... Ugh, again... Everyone loved my drinks! Gah... Don't try to comfort me. I—I don't need comforting!

voices.title: Good Night
voices.text: Without cat vision, will you be okay walking home in the dark? If you need me to escort you... What? Th—There's lights? Pff, well who said anything about escorting you? Go on now.

voices.title: About Diona
voices.text: My ears and tail are no prop, they're real. Proof of my Kätzlein bloodline. It's only weird to you cause you've never seen it before. Wh—Why are you looking at me like that? Fine. You can touch my ears for a second, but the tail is off limits!

voices.title: About Us: Drinks
voices.text: You want a non-alcoholic drink? No, that's not difficult, but it's meaningless! It doesn't have anything to do with my grand plan of destroying the wine industry of Mondstadt. I won't waste my time on such a drink, hmph!

voices.title: About Us: VIP Channels
voices.text: Here! I call this Fantastic Summer-Serendipity Coral Sparkling Tea, I just made it one day when I was bored... Huh, you say it's popular? People are lining up to buy it? Don't be ridiculous.

voices.title: About Us: The Need to Chat
voices.text: Well, if you ever feel lonely, you can chat with me. I know lots of cool things~ I'm a good... what's that called... chatting partner! Yeah! A good chatting partner, come chat with me... lots... ...okay?

voices.title: About Us: Curiosity
voices.text: What's that!? What's that!? Let me see! Maybe I can add it to my next cocktail to give it a dreadful taste... Huh? It's just a strange-looking mushroom, how boring...

voices.title: About the Vision: Heirloom
voices.text: How did I get my Vision? Simple — everyone in the Kätzlein lineage gets one. ...Huh? Then why doesn't Draff have a Vision? Uhh... Oh no, the cat's out of the bag! Eek!

voices.title: About the Vision: Origin
voices.text: Why should I tell you!? Hmph! ...*sigh* Since you won't stop asking... and since we are friends, I'll tell you: One time, my daddy went missing on a hunt in a big storm. All I could think of was finding him, saving him... That's it, are you happy now?

voices.title: Something to Share
voices.text: Hey, do you think there are any exotic plants on Dragonspine? Maybe something with a deadly bitterness, or something that numbs your mouth upon contact? I'm going to pick a lot! And then... hehehe-hee-hee...

voices.title: Interesting Things
voices.text: When it comes to butterflies, I'm the best at pouncing on— err, catching them. Hey, not in a fun way! I catch butterflies to add a nasty taste to my cocktails. I'm not a cat! Meow! *hiss*

voices.title: About Diluc
voices.text: Diluc... I can't stand him! If there was no Diluc, there would be no Mondstadt wine industry; if there was no Mondstadt wine industry, Daddy wouldn't drink; and if Daddy didn't drink... he would keep me company. Ohhhh...

voices.title: About Kaeya
voices.text: How is it that even a captain is a disgusting boozehound! You know, that guy who's got that laugh! He downs drink after drink. Ugh!

voices.title: About Venti
voices.text: Venti? I'm not familiar with him... He's a bard? Oh, he must be that guy who sings tunes to entertain the drunkards. Well, then I don't like him, no no no...

voices.title: About Barbara
voices.text: How come all my fans are drunk middle-aged men, while Barbara's are all young people...? Hmph! So stupid. Forget it!

voices.title: About Jean
voices.text: Acting Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius... A rare, mature adult who doesn't drink... But perhaps a little too earnest, cause is it just me, or are the Knights overdoing it a bit on protecting me?

voices.title: About Albedo
voices.text: Alchemy genius? Hmm... I wonder if he knows of a way to finally help me make a drink that people don't like?

voices.title: About Lisa
voices.text: Lisa is so nice and gentle! But... how can such a gentle person also be a regular drinker!? Ohhhh... Why!? ...There's really no hope for Mondstadt, is there?

voices.title: About Xiangling
voices.text: Xiangling once gave me a "so-awful-it-goes-with-nothing" food combination she came up with, saying how it tasted absolutely terrible, blah blah blah... It didn't work, no use at all. All my little cat ears heard that night was "One more cup of that good stuff!" *sigh*

voices.title: About Klee
voices.text: Every time Klee wants to play with me, I take her somewhere far from the tavern. Alcohol and explosives... yeah, that's a dangerous combination! I mean, do I want to destroy the wine industry of Mondstadt? Yes, but not in that sense!

voices.title: About Her Father
voices.text: I adore my daddy more than anyone else! He's the greatest! But... Daddy after he drinks, ugh... Argh! I must bring an end to the wine industry of Mondstadt, and soon! No time for chit-chat!

voices.title: More About Diona: I
voices.text: Life as a mixologist is very busy! When I'm not at the tavern, I'm out collecting ingredients for new recipes. So... So unless something is urgent, don't bother me.

voices.title: More About Diona: II
voices.text: You wouldn't ask me to meow like a cat, like those boozehounds at the tavern do, would you? I wouldn't do it, no way! I'm not some little house pet that just shakes my ears real cute and stretches my back! I'm... I'm Diona, Destroyer of the Wine Industry!

voices.title: More About Diona: III
voices.text: "How did the Destroyer of the Wine Industry become the Cat's Tail's mascot...?" Y—You're asking this just to make fun of me! Ohhh, you're awful! I won't be giving YOU any more drinks, not even water.

voices.title: More About Diona: IV
voices.text: Don't, don't make me angry. I'm pretty tolerant, but don't even try to mess with me. I'm warning you, I bite when I get angry! Meow!!! ...But maybe I'd let you off easy, no bites...

voices.title: More About Diona: V
voices.text: You and me... we're good friends now, right? I kind of remember having a friend like this before, but maybe it was a dream... Here, give me your hand. Ahh... Hmm, nice and warm... Very nice... please don't leave me, and become another dream.

voices.title: Diona's Hobbies
voices.text: I enjoy hunting. I'm especially good at tracking down prey! But Daddy says that the wild is dangerous. One should only go deep into the forest with a reliable adult. ...You're a reliable adult, right?

voices.title: Diona's Troubles
voices.text: How, oh how can I make awful-tasting drinks...? I had high hopes for the soy sauce, milk, Jueyun Chili, and Dandelion Seed cocktail — my most nightmarish combination to date! But even that was met with praise at the tavern. "This is Little Diona's best drink yet..." Grr! But I won't give up...

voices.title: Favorite Food
voices.text: I like, no, LOVE to eat fish! The fish Daddy cooks is the best, a purrfect main course! ...But eating fish as drunk food, that's absolute blasphemy!

voices.title: Least Favorite Food
voices.text: Carrots, potatoes, onions, tomatoes... I don't like the taste of any of those vegetables. ...In fact, I don't eat vegetables at all!

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: I
voices.text: Mmm! I just wanna ask you this... Will you bring more of it next time?

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: II
voices.text: I'll admit, that was pretty sweet... but that doesn't mean I haven't had sweeter.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: III
voices.text: Hey... What do you take me for, some sort of stray cat!?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Here you go — fried fish with my special sauce! ...Relax, I didn't add anything strange! My cooking is actually really good when I want it to be — stop talking and try it already! Hmph... that's better... Oh, and uh, happy birthday.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Intro
voices.text: A cat's eyes can see even the most elusive prey in the dark.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Building Up
voices.text: A cat's ears can hear even the softest footsteps on the ground.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Climax
voices.text: A cat's legs can climb even the tallest tree in all of Teyvat.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Conclusion
voices.text: A cat's nose can smell those people they are familiar with and like... Ahh!? You're mistaken, how could I say something like that... Ohh...

voices.title: Elemental Skill: I
voices.text: Hey-yah!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: II
voices.text: Pew-Pew~!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: III
voices.text: On the rocks!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: IV
voices.text: Shaken and stirred!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: V
voices.text: Scratched ya!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: VI
voices.text: Think you can bully me?!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: I
voices.text: Diona Special!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: II
voices.text: Can't handle your drink? Hmph!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: III
voices.text: Look at you, boozehound!

voices.title: Sprint Start: I
voices.text: Ha, I'm here.

voices.title: Sprint Start: II
voices.text: Let's go, let's go!

voices.title: Sprint End: I
voices.text: Phew.

voices.title: Sprint End: II
voices.text: Phew, hoo.

voices.title: Deploying Wind Glider: I
voices.text: I'm flying!

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: I
voices.text: If it doesn't ruin a drink, it isn't treasure!

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: II
voices.text: So glittery... Must... control... urge to pounce...

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: III
voices.text: Potential treasure... *sigh* Alright curiosity, you win again!

voices.title: Low HP: I
voices.text: I won't accept defeat!

voices.title: Low HP: II
voices.text: Meow...!

voices.title: Low HP: III
voices.text: It's not over yet!

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: I
voices.text: Be more careful!

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: II
voices.text: Take a breather!

voices.title: Fallen: I
voices.text: Bleugh... I smell wine.

voices.title: Fallen: II
voices.text: Spring fairy... ugh... Don't leave me...

voices.title: Fallen: III
voices.text: Can't keep my eyes... open...

voices.title: Light Hit Taken: I
voices.text: Got me that time...

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: I
voices.text: Where'd that come from!?

voices.title: Joining Party: I
voices.text: The hunt begins!

voices.title: Joining Party: II
voices.text: Huh, need my help as usual?

voices.title: Joining Party: III
voices.text: Hehe, leave it to me!
